boundary_rule: one segment: SemanticKITTI odometry sequence 08, the 815 unique stride-5 frames in odometry order. One physical stream.
exclusion_reason: none: every canonical anchor sits at stream position >= 4, the causal window needs four earlier frames, and the mode-B gauge is complete after position 4, so the initialization requirement excludes no anchor

mode_A.reset: once per evaluation anchor (per five-frame clip)
mode_A.scale: estimated from that clip's own five frames

mode_B.scale: one scalar from the segment's first five frames, frozen for the rest of the segment; no later MoGe call, no refresh
mode_B.mapper_window: the same five causal frames the reference uses for that anchor; the explicit occupancy-map window is NOT widened, only LingBot's own state persists

end_condition.rule: last frame of the physical segment
